title: rosa arvensis var. globosa
intro: Rosa arvensis var. globosa, commonly known as the wild rose or field rose, is a variant of the Rosa arvensis plant species found in the wild. It is a flowering plant known for its fragrant flowers and edible hips, which are rich in vitamins and antioxidants. The hips of the Rosa arvensis var. globosa plant have been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to their health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as their ability to aid in digestion and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting immune function.
